description: PLAT-006 / PLAT-012: explicit, scoped, owned allowlist of files permitted to touch platform/storage primitives directly. Every entry is regression-tested by tests/unit/boundary-lint.test.ts (PLAT-012: exception manifest integrity). The boundary lint (scripts/boundary-lint.ts) fails closed for any direct platform-primitive access NOT covered here.

exceptions.rationale: The single browser-local IndexedDB storage adapter required by ADR-014. It is the only module allowed to import Dexie or touch IndexedDB; the GUI reaches durable state exclusively through the named StoragePort methods (PLAT-006).
exceptions.removalCriteria: Replace or augment only when ADR-014's prototype storage decision changes (e.g. OPFS/SQLite). A replacement adapter must keep the same StoragePort contract and platform-service boundary validation.

exceptions.rationale: Device-local pinned/recent navigation is an explicitly device-scoped UI preference (Contract 1/2), never durable vault or sync state. localStorage is the correct prototype store and is guarded by typeof checks plus corrupt-data fallbacks.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if device-local navigation preferences move into a typed platform preferences adapter; until then localStorage access stays confined to this file.

exceptions.rationale: Capability/environment probes that read indexedDB availability, navigator.onLine, and the raw viewport (window.innerWidth + matchMedia pointer queries) ONCE so GUI components branch on the resolved platform profile / capability facts, not raw globals (PLAT-001 / Contract 1 Platform Profile Selection). This is the single owned place the raw viewport may be read; the boundary lint forbids viewport sniffing everywhere else.
exceptions.removalCriteria: The raw global/viewport reads must remain confined to this platform-layer probe. Remove only if profile resolution moves into a dedicated platform-profile service module that keeps the reads out of feature components.

exceptions.rationale: Device-local theme preference (UX-VIS-001/003) is an explicitly device-scoped UI display preference (Contract 1), never durable vault or sync state. localStorage persists the choice and matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') resolves the OS preference for the `system` option; both are guarded by typeof checks with corrupt-data/no-API fallbacks. This is OS colour-scheme detection, not layout-profile viewport sniffing (PLAT-001), and stays confined to this platform-layer store.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if device-local display preferences move into a typed platform preferences adapter and OS colour-scheme detection moves into the shared capability probe; until then theme persistence and the colour-scheme query stay confined to this file.

exceptions.rationale: Device-local motion preference (UX-VIS-010 / A11Y-005) is an explicitly device-scoped UI display preference (Contract 1), never durable vault or sync state. localStorage persists the user's explicit motion choice; reads/writes are guarded by typeof checks with corrupt-data/no-API fallbacks. The OS reduced-motion probe stays in the owned capability surface (capabilities.ts, viewport-sniff exception); this store only persists the choice.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if device-local display preferences move into a typed platform preferences adapter; until then motion persistence stays confined to this file.

exceptions.rationale: Device-local Desktop density preference (UX-VIS-011) is an explicitly device-scoped UI display preference (Contract 1), never durable vault or sync state. localStorage persists the Desktop override; reads/writes are guarded by typeof checks with corrupt-data/no-API fallbacks. Density is derived from the resolved platform viewport class handed in by the shell, so this store performs NO viewport sniffing — only preference persistence.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if device-local display preferences move into a typed platform preferences adapter; until then density persistence stays confined to this file.

exceptions.rationale: Device-local Desktop sidebar icon-rail collapse state (UX-NAV-004) is an explicitly device-scoped UI display preference (Contract 1), never durable vault or sync state. localStorage persists the collapse choice so it survives a reload (UX-NAV-004 AC3); reads/writes are guarded by typeof checks with try/catch fallbacks (private mode / no API) and default to expanded on first launch. No viewport sniffing — only preference persistence.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if device-local display preferences move into a typed platform preferences adapter; until then collapse-state persistence stays confined to this file.

exceptions.rationale: Device-local coach-mark seen-state (UX-ONB-013/017) is an explicitly device-scoped UI display preference (Contract 1), never durable vault or sync state. localStorage persists which first-reach hints the user has dismissed so they never fire again across sessions (UX-ONB-013 AC2); the per-session frequency cap stays in memory. Reads/writes are guarded by typeof checks with try/catch + corrupt-data fallbacks. No viewport sniffing — only preference persistence.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if device-local display preferences move into a typed platform preferences adapter; until then coach-mark seen-state persistence stays confined to this file.

exceptions.rationale: Device-local "What's New" seen-version (UX-ONB-020) is an explicitly device-scoped UI display preference (Contract 1), never durable vault or sync state. localStorage persists the last-seen release version so the passive "?" badge clears once the help center is opened and stays cleared across reloads. Reads/writes are guarded by typeof checks with try/catch fallbacks. No viewport sniffing — only preference persistence.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if device-local display preferences move into a typed platform preferences adapter; until then changelog seen-version persistence stays confined to this file.

exceptions.rationale: Device-local spatial-dashboard board layout (Command Center redesign) is an explicitly device-scoped UI display preference (Contract 1), never durable vault or sync state — the home Scene's tool widgets stay core-owned (scene.move-widget / presets / safe point). localStorage persists block geometry + per-widget display options so a user's board arrangement survives reload. Reads/writes are typeof-guarded with try/catch + corrupt-data fallbacks. No viewport sniffing — only preference persistence.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if device-local display preferences move into a typed platform preferences adapter; until then board-layout persistence stays confined to this file.

exceptions.rationale: The runtime constructs the CoreEnvironment id generator and clock from browser crypto/Date. This is platform-service wiring behind the runtime boundary; GUI components call runtime.newId() rather than crypto directly (PLAT-006).
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove if id/clock generation moves into a dedicated platform service module; the crypto access must stay out of GUI components.
